macro_weather.regime_description: Rising rates, dollar weak, credit softening, gold soft, copper firm (growth), oil rising (inflation), copper/gold reflation tilt (risk-on).

held_book.beta_basis: Both windows provided; AQE makes NO gate call. Charter v2.1 §6.4 portfolio gate = β60d (use *_60d); PHL Field Spec = β30d (unsuffixed).

qs_market.action: No edge in this market. Manage open positions only.

inputs.trend_200_meaning: equal-weight universe index vs its own 200-day average (+0.13 = 13% above trend)
inputs.vol_60_meaning: annualised stdev of that index's daily returns over 60 sessions (0.15 = 15%)
inputs.method: T = which third of TREND, V = which third of VOLATILITY. Terciles are fitted on an EXPANDING history shifted one day, so the boundaries classifying today come only from prior days — no lookahead.

lens_ranking.method: Count of lenses reading `strong`. UNWEIGHTED — no weighting was ever earned, so none is applied. Sort only: nothing is filtered, capped, or eliminated. Every scored name is here.
lens_ranking.extension_note: `extension` is data-only and NEVER counted. The voices disagree on what extension means, so AQE prints the numbers (subcomponents.flow.ext_score, energy.en_pos50 / exhaustion_score / atr_score) and makes no call.
lens_ranking.reading_aid_not_a_prediction: Whether 5-of-6 outperforms 2-of-6 is UNTESTED. Testing it would require the weighting we refused. This exists to make the read consistent and cheap.

signal_radar.note: DETECTION tags only -- NOT entry signals, NOT sizing. The PM/AIC decides entry/bracket/size live. Every % is a detection rate (price-path only), never a win rate. No tag informs sizing until its paper-track shows PASS.
